problem_type: Connection creation bypasses slot and cross-field capacity
symptom: A selected batch can create 12 media edges while three uploaded audio references already consume part of a 12-file total.
direct_cause: Group materialization checks reference media compatibility but never checks filled slot capacity.
class_root: Connection acceptance and upload acceptance did not share the reference fill budget.
affected_population: Manual single, multi-selection and group connections into models with bounded slots or maxTotalReferences
internal_only_reason: The existing archetype and remainingReferenceCapacity already declare the product invariant; the missing step is connecting graph creation to that owner.
invariants: A new connection must fit its resolved slot and the mode total, including uploaded and pending references.
Mode promotion and all edges from one gesture undo together.
generality_proof: Every graph materialization uses resolveCanvasReferenceConnection; its capacity check uses the exact assignEdgeToSlot and resolveReferenceSlots used by consumers, plus remainingReferenceCapacity used by upload controls.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Validate reference compatibility and capacity before adding edges.
Reuse placement/fills and cross-field budget, projecting a prospective promoted mode without mutating the store.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Single and selected connections call the resolver before committing edges.
Both call the same resolver; output materialization passes the progressively appended edges.

recurrence.reason: Any bounded model and any mix of uploads and pending sources can exceed budget through graph creation.
same_class_scan: rg remainingReferenceCapacity maxTotalReferences src/workbench/generationCanvas: only upload controls used the shared count.
Read canvasReferenceConnection.ts and referenceEdgeCapability.ts: compatibility was enforced but total was absent.
Read materializeGroupLink and materializeGroupOutputLink: both flow through resolveCanvasReferenceConnection.

prevention.invariant: No new accepted media edge exceeds available slot or total capacity.
prevention.failure_mode: Reject with the existing unsupported_reference reason; batches count skipped entries without creating phantom edges.
prevention.strategy: Resolve the prospective mode and count existing fills before materializing each new reference.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replaces compatibility-only acceptance with the shared capacity check; no parallel resolver.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Internal archetype and graph invariant; no dependency upgrade is involved.

migration: No persisted graph rewrite; new gestures respect limits. Existing legacy over-capacity edges remain user-authored data and are not silently deleted.
residual_risks: Legacy already-saved over-capacity graphs are not rewritten by this change.
